en: And he had no idea how to do RunPod Flash.
zh: 而他完全不知道怎么用 RunPod Flash。

speaker: Unknown
en: He had to ask me questions if this was even possible.
zh: 他还得问我这到底可不可能做到。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm like, let's see.
zh: 我说，试试看吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: And he was very surprised when he won yesterday because his project was not even his best one apparently.
zh: 而且他昨天获胜时非常惊讶，因为据说他的项目甚至不是他最好的一个。

speaker: Unknown
en: And he keeps losing to other hackathons.
zh: 他还在其他黑客松上一直输。

speaker: Unknown
en: So just really proud of this guy.
zh: 所以我真心为这家伙感到骄傲。

speaker: Unknown
en: How do you get started with RunPod Flash?
zh: 你要怎么开始使用 RunPod Flash？

speaker: Unknown
en: So you sign up for an account on RunPod, scan that QR code, get some $10 credit now, and all you really have to do is just install it, write your code, log in to have your API key in there, initialize, you'll have some skeleton application if you want.
zh: 你在 RunPod 上注册一个账号，扫那个二维码，现在可以获得 10 美元的额度，而你真正需要做的就是安装它，写你的代码，登录把你的 API key 放进去，初始化，如果你需要的话还有一些骨架应用程序可以用。

speaker: Unknown
en: Flash Dev, the local dev that you have, or Flash Deploy to production.
zh: Flash Dev 是你本地的开发环境，或者用 Flash Deploy 部署到生产环境。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we have all these URLs.
zh: 我们有所有这些 URL。

speaker: Unknown
en: The best advice I have is visit the RunPod Flash examples on GitHub because we have all these cases and examples that you could kind of refer.
zh: 我最好的建议是去 GitHub 上看 RunPod Flash 的示例，因为我们有各种案例和示例可以供你参考。

speaker: Unknown
en: Or if you like AI coding, just run Cloud Code into that repository and it will learn everything.
zh: 或者如果你喜欢 AI 编程，直接把 Cloud Code 跑到那个仓库里，它就会学会一切。

speaker: Unknown
en: We also have skills if you're into that.
zh: 如果你喜欢的话，我们还有 skills。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that is my presentation.
zh: 这就是我的演讲。

en: Music .
